notes: TBox expansion, paired with people-replace-0007. Keeps the revision's relation (has_term_length) and new conclusion (a six-year term) and gives it to a made-up office, Chancellor of Harlsworth University, under the real class of university offices, so no old value is pushed out. The derived queries name invented chancellors with the office stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route to the length. The near unrelated query asks the real four-year presidential term, which must not move to six; a method that learned a bare 'office term is six years' mapping would leak there. University and chancellor names are invented; the counting step records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
